desc: Tactical Solutions X-Ring Takedown VR rifle is lightweight, collapsible, durable and compact. The rifle comes fully equipped with our X-RING TD Barrel and X-Ring TD Receiver, a built-in scope rail for optics, an extended magazine release for quick and easy magazine removal, a cleaning port for easy cleaning, a heat-dissipating fluted barrel, a dual guide rod system that provides smooth cycling and a threaded muzzle to easily attach a silencer or compensator. The TD Barrel is hand-chambered for .22 LR, has a target crown and chromoly steel bore, comes standard with a fully adjustable rear sight and fiber optic front sights and is machined from 6061-T6 aluminum with a .920" diameter target contour profile. Suppressors are easily attached by simply twisting them on the barrel's threaded end.
